description: This file defines types and functions related to provider authentication choices, including resolving choices from plugin manifests, handling deprecated choices, and generating CLI flags.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderAuthChoices
methods.description: Resolves provider authentication choices from plugin registry based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderAuthChoice
methods.description: Finds a specific provider auth choice by choiceId.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderApiKeyChoice
methods.description: Resolves a provider API key choice based on providerId.

methods.name: resolveManifestDeprecatedProviderAuthChoice
methods.description: Finds a deprecated provider auth choice by choiceId.

methods.name: resolveManifestProviderOnboardAuthFlags
methods.description: Generates CLI flags for provider onboarding authentication choices.
